content:
q17.

**`web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts`; `memoServiceClient`**

This module holds the memo CRUD mutations and queries — `useCreateMemo` (`memoServiceClient.createMemo`, line 183), `useUpdateMemo` (`updateMemo`, line 202), `useDeleteMemo` (`deleteMemo`, line 258), plus read queries `useMemos`/`useInfiniteMemos` (`listMemos`), `useMemo` (`getMemo`), and comment queries. All are TanStack Query `useMutation`/`useQuery` wrappers.

The generated service client it uses is `memoServiceClient`, imported from `@/connect` (`web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts:5`) and defined at `web/src/connect.ts:197` as `createClient(MemoService, transport)` over the generated `MemoService` type in `web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service_pb.ts`.
